meta.name: BET Holiday Movies
meta.description:
Celebrate the season with holiday movies that bring joy, love, and laughter to the holidays. Pluto TV’s BET Holiday Movies channel delivers festive favorites and heartwarming stories 24/7, perfect for the whole family.

Shows: A New Husband for Christmas, Holiday Hideaway, Missing You This Christmas, A Holiday for Harmony, Stuck on Christmas
Available on: Pluto TV
